verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents multi-person availability lookup (slots by usernames for when 2 or more people are free) and an MCP server that external AI clients can use. Nothing in the evidence shows Cal.com itself using AI to rank or pick the best time, or to keep re-optimizing a meeting time across attendees' calendars. Those features only list open slots or let a third-party AI build on the API, so they are adjacent building blocks, not the capability.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, AI finds and continuously optimizes the best meeting time across all attendees' calendars, not just the first open slot
